title: GTA 6 Has Literal Easter Eggs
yt_title: Rockstar Hid LITERAL Easter Eggs In GTA 6 😂 #shorts
description:
Players climbing radio antennas above Vice City found bird nests with real painted Easter eggs, covered in bird poop. And you can play video games inside your safehouse.

#GTA6 #GTAVI #EasterEgg

lines.text: Rockstar trolled everyone hunting for GTA 6 Easter eggs.
Climb the giant radio antennas above Vice City.
Up top, players found bird nests with real painted Easter eggs.
And of course, they're covered in bird poop.
It gets weirder, you can play video games inside your safehouse.
A game inside a game, inside GTA.
What's the best secret you've found so far?
